samples.question: Can I restart after stopping?
samples.answer: Groww's help says that once you cancel an SIP, the cancellation cannot be undone, but you can create a new SIP in the same fund, and the amount will be added to your investment. Your passbook shows this SIP as stopped since 20 Oct 2026, so a new SIP would be a separate instruction. Groww's help also notes that you cannot cancel an SIP if the next instalment is due within 7 days. Your official record is your Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) from MF Central, CAMS or KFintech.
